name: Gudbrandsdalsleden
description_md:
Gudbrandsdalsleden is a waymarked hiking route in Norway spanning 228.2 km. The national waymarked hiking network route matches the official line published by turrutebasen.

The hard route features 5075 m of ascent and 4901 m of descent. Walking time is about 70 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, with difficulty derived from distance and ascent. Along the way, the route passes the Munch museum within 200 m, MUNCH within 500 m, and the Museum of Cultural History within 600 m.
